text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's commerce minister arrives in Damascus and holds talks on ways of developing trade and economic links with Syria.
- A small fire breaks out at a power station unit in Manama.
- Cabinet discusses developing Shura council and plans to increase its members. The council will focus on reactivating the economy and pushing forward the development process.
